title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 52
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 52: the reign of Zedekiah, the fall and burning of Jerusalem, the captives carried away and the release of Jehoiachin.

questions.text: How old was Zedekiah when he began to reign, and how long did he reign in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

answers.text: Twenty-one years old, and he reigned eleven years
Eight years old, and he reigned thirty-one years
Twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty years
Thirty years old, and he reigned three years

questions.text: What was the name of Zedekiah's mother?
questions.explanation: His mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

answers.text: Hamutal the daughter of Josiah
Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan
Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah
Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah

questions.text: When did Nebuchadnezzar come with all his army against Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: He came in the ninth year of Zedekiah's reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, and encamped against the city.

answers.text: In the fourth year, the fourth month, on the ninth day
In the ninth year, the tenth month, on the tenth day
In the seventh year, the second month, on the first day
In the first year, the first month, on the first day

questions.text: What happened in the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month?
questions.explanation: The famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

answers.text: The temple of Yahweh was burned with fire
The king was crowned again in Jerusalem
The walls of the city were rebuilt
The famine was severe, with no bread for the people

questions.text: Where did the army of the Chaldeans overtake Zedekiah?
questions.explanation: The army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho, and all his army was scattered from him.

answers.text: In the plains of Jericho
By the river Euphrates
In the wilderness of Judah
At the gate of Jerusalem

questions.text: What did the king of Babylon do to Zedekiah?
questions.explanation: He killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, put out Zedekiah's eyes, bound him in fetters, carried him to Babylon and put him in prison until the day of his death.

answers.text: He set him on a throne in Babylon
He sent him back to rule in Jerusalem
He killed his sons, put out his eyes and imprisoned him
He sent him away to Egypt bound in fetters

questions.text: Who came into Jerusalem and burned Yahweh's house and the king's house?
questions.explanation: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard came into Jerusalem and burned Yahweh's house, the king's house and every great house of the city.

answers.text: Nebuchadnezzar himself
Seraiah the chief priest
Evilmerodach king of Babylon
Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard

questions.text: What did Nebuzaradan leave the poorest of the land to be?
questions.explanation: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.

answers.text: Soldiers to guard the city
Vineyard keepers and farmers
Priests for the temple
Servants in Babylon

questions.text: How many people in all were carried away captive, according to the count given?
questions.explanation: The chapter lists the captives of three years and says that all the people were four thousand six hundred.

answers.text: Four thousand six hundred
Ten thousand and forty
One thousand two hundred
Seven thousand and seventy

questions.text: What did Evilmerodach king of Babylon do for Jehoiachin king of Judah?
questions.explanation: He lifted up the head of Jehoiachin and released him from prison, spoke kindly to him, set his throne above the thrones of the kings who were with him in Babylon and changed his prison garments.

answers.text: He sent him back to Judah to reign as king
He put him to death in the city of Babylon
He released him from prison and spoke kindly to him
He gave him charge of all the army
